items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 38:1
items.html: The couplings of the Partzufim, in regard to the fixed Mochin in Atzilut, are considered a coupling that is not entirely complete, and this is for two reasons: First, in relation to their former state that they had in Nekudim, they lack the nine lower Sefirot, as said above in answer 83. Second, that they cannot bestow upon ZON the Mochin of the birth of souls, but only the Mochin of AHBA alone. (Inner Light, page 661, Sub Header, “Now”)
